# omada_time_range (Resource)

Manages a reusable time-range (schedule) profile.

Other objects reference a time range rather than carrying their own schedule, so this is what makes scheduling usable at all — an SSID's schedule flag, for example, needs a profile to point at.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A reusable schedule profile. Other objects reference a time range rather than
# carrying their own schedule, so this is the piece that makes an SSID schedule
# or a time-bounded firewall rule possible.
resource "omada_time_range" "night_run" {
  name = "night run"

  monday    = true
  tuesday   = true
  wednesday = true
  thursday  = true
  friday    = true
  saturday  = true
  sunday    = true

  # 03:00 -> 06:00
  time_slots {
    start_hour = 3
    end_hour   = 6
  }
}

# Several windows per profile are allowed.
resource "omada_time_range" "office_hours" {
  name = "office hours"

  monday    = true
  tuesday   = true
  wednesday = true
  thursday  = true
  friday    = true

  time_slots {
    start_hour = 9
    end_hour   = 12
  }

  time_slots {
    start_hour   = 12
    start_minute = 30
    end_hour     = 17
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name.

### Optional

- `day_mode` (Number) Controller day-selection mode. `0` uses the per-weekday flags below.
- `friday` (Boolean) Active on Friday.
- `monday` (Boolean) Active on Monday.
- `saturday` (Boolean) Active on Saturday.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.
- `sunday` (Boolean) Active on Sunday.
- `thursday` (Boolean) Active on Thursday.
- `time_slots` (Block List) One or more start/end windows, in 24-hour local time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--time_slots))
- `tuesday` (Boolean) Active on Tuesday.
- `wednesday` (Boolean) Active on Wednesday.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `site_id` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--time_slots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_slots`

Required:

- `end_hour` (Number) End hour, 0-24.
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour, 0-23.

Optional:

- `day_type` (Number) Controller day-type discriminator; `0` for an ordinary window.
- `end_minute` (Number) End minute, 0-59.
- `start_minute` (Number) Start minute, 0-59.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By profile ID, or "<site>/<id>" to be explicit about the site.
terraform import omada_time_range.night_run 6a54bb64cea3911d963181fc
terraform import omada_time_range.night_run 'Home/6a54bb64cea3911d963181fc'
```
